title: NoiseFloorEstimator — noise learn, per-band percentile, slow adaptation
description:
Implement Source/DSP/NoiseFloorEstimator for Noise Learn workflow, per-band percentile noise-floor estimation, suggested threshold/hysteresis floors, and optional slow adaptation while confidently closed.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md section 12 (workflow, noise-floor estimation, slow adaptation, profile display fields)
- Source/DSP/DetectorEngine.* log-energy / envelope surfaces L or L_b
- Source/ParameterIDs.h for noise-learn / threshold recommendation IDs if present
- Existing Source/DSP/ prepare/reset/process style and any multiband band-count constants already in the project

Implement NoiseFloorEstimator.h/.cpp per spec §12:
- Learn workflow state: Idle → Capturing (several seconds of observations while user is not playing) → Ready (suggestions available) → Applied/Frozen; support startLearn(), cancelLearn(), applySuggestions(), freeze(), resetProfile(). Capture must use preallocated ring/bucket storage sized in prepare(); no audio-thread heap growth.
- For each band b (broadband + configured LF/MID/HF or project band count), collect log-energy observations L_b[t] and compute:
  N_b = percentile_p({L_b[t]}) with p in [0.20, 0.50] (settable, default mid-range)
  T_b = N_b + M_b where M_b is desired SNR margin (settable)
- Build reviewable suggestions: open/close thresholds, hysteresis, high-band/Hiss floor, and hum-rejection enable hint flags from measured idle energy. Suggestions must NOT silently mutate live thresholds until applySuggestions() is called.
- Optional slow adaptation while gate is confidently closed:
  N_b[t] = lambda * N_b[t-1] + (1-lambda) * L_b[t]
  Reject updates on transient activity, signal above noise model, harmonicity/sustain suggesting a musical note, or external-key-active conditions (inputs as process flags). Must not chase decaying notes.
- Expose getters for broadband floor, per-band floors, confidence, capture duration, idle spike/intermittent indicators as cheap summary stats for later GUI (no GUI work here).
- prepare(sampleRate, maxBlockSize)/reset(); realtime-safe observation path when capturing or slow-adapting.

Do NOT implement CadenceTracker, AlignmentAnalyzer, or FractionalDelay. Do NOT edit PluginProcessor or CMakeLists.txt (e.4). Do NOT write tests (e.5).

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: NoiseFloorEstimator supports Learn workflow states including capture, ready suggestions, apply, freeze, and reset
NoiseFloorEstimator computes per-band N_b = percentile_p(L_b) with p in [0.20, 0.50] and T_b = N_b + M_b
Suggested thresholds/hysteresis/floors are not applied to live parameters until applySuggestions() is invoked
Optional slow adaptation N_b[t] = lambda * N_b[t-1] + (1-lambda) * L_b[t] updates only when confidently closed and rejection conditions are false
No heap allocation in the per-block observation/adaptation path
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

allowed: use plain C++20 + JUCE types already in the project
fixed-capacity observation buffers and band arrays sized in prepare
accept per-band log-energy and gate/closed/harmonicity/key-active flags as process inputs
forbidden: auto-apply learn results without an explicit apply API
FFT-heavy spectral analyzer required for v1 noise floor math
